body: vterm.Screen.Write() now accumulates multi-byte UTF-8 sequences via utf8Buf[4]. Invalid/truncated sequences emit U+FFFD. font.Atlas pre-rendered at init() for 0x20-0x7E. 9 vterm tests pass (including TestUTF8Rune: 'café' decodes and positions cursor at col 4).
title: S45-03: UTF-8 multi-byte decode in vterm.Write + pre-rendered ASCII glyph atlas at init
